headline_application_PSS_all_phases.scope: Sampled all-phase application-tree maximum; non-atomic and partial residency, not required RAM

native_reuse_preparation.preparation_clock_scope: Durations internal to preparation process only; no monotonic comparison across host/boot

platform.scope: Exact fresh root API UID/PVC/image binding plus local mount, resource, idle GPU and owned-file probes. Sampled admission, no capacity reservation, continuous health, exclusive cores or bandwidth claim.

scope: Independent raw clocks/PSS/CPU brackets/source/provenance checks. No producer import or recorded path access. Source-bound graph/native/input identities, not independent payload regeneration.

latest_inventory.scope: Non-atomic sampled output-byte cap, not an instantaneous quota; vanished entries are skipped and counted, observed bytes are never subtracted.

storage_block.scope: Each recorded available-byte/inode/readonly/device threshold and latest sampled inventory checked. Byte availability was derived by pinned statvfs code; raw block components were not serialized. Initial dataset-native-bytes-plus6GiB/positive exposed inodes admission is checked separately from runtime4GiB/positive exposed inodes. No instantaneous quota, capacity reservation, node eviction or continuous-health guarantee.
